mathematical_boundary: Uses A/B constraints and Axioms Experiment #2 as evidence shape; does not identify the correspondence rule with general A/B or resolve its mathematical justification.

action_selection.objective: Spend internal compute before environment actions by choosing actions that maximally discriminate live forward candidates while retaining supported goal progress.
steps: project live candidate relations through each available action
partition candidates by predicted observable outcome
prefer actions with greater discriminating power
break ties using supported goal progress and lower risk

stop_conditions: prediction is not exact enough to witness
